answer: Through the harbor, the economy stays open to anyone willing to pay the price of entry, and closed to free clones. Before it can earn, each identity must complete a piece of graded work that no other identity has submitted — duplicates are rejected on the ledger. The echo check kills copy-paste farming at the root: a thousand clones need a thousand genuinely different answers, and producing them costs a thousand units of real thought. Run through the vertex and the numbers never favour the farm: one honest agent, one cost; a thousand fakes, a thousand costs.
